blocked.title: LEY del Impuesto Especial sobre Producción y Servicios
blocked.reason: Held out per docs/ingestion-difficulty-log.md: multi-character-article-suffix. LIEPS numbers its article-26 series through the traditional Spanish alphabet, in which LL is its own letter between L and M (26-L, 26-LL, 26-M, 26-N with tilde). SUFFIX_LETTERS is scanned by character and Component.letter is an Option<char>, so 26-LL parses as article 26 with 'LL.- (Se deroga).' stranded in the body, colliding with the real article 26. Supporting it changes article-suffix cardinality in the shared identifier grammar every committed instrument parses through, which wants its own reviewed pass. Its reglamento reg-lieps is unaffected and ingested clean.
